method: For each 65-character hexadecimal image digest, remove the final extra hexadecimal character so the stored field conforms to SHA-256's 64-character representation.
limitations: The raw image bytes were not retained and the device stream was unavailable during repair; the corrected values are format-normalized prefixes of the recorded values, not independently recomputed hashes.
A future fresh read must replace these values with hashes computed directly from reacquired image bytes before any high-assurance evidence use.
